اصطلحت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَلَحْتُ (iṣṭalaḥtu) /isˤ.tˤa.laħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# اِصْطَلَحْتَ (iṣṭalaḥta) /isˤ.tˤa.laħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# اِصْطَلَحْتِ (iṣṭalaḥti) /isˤ.tˤa.laħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# اِصْطَلَحَتْ (iṣṭalaḥat) /isˤ.tˤa.la.ħat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
